_meta.notes: Input format for scripts/report.py. Required: title, headline, confidence (level + reason), and at least one caveat or data_quality note. Get a filled-in example with: python3 scripts/report.py --example. Validate with: python3 scripts/report.py REPORT.json --check. Text fields are plain text; **double stars** make bold; a blank line starts a new paragraph.

subtitle.description: Data source and period, one line.

headline.description: The finding in one sentence with the key number. This is the first thing the reader sees.

reason.description: Why: sample size, data quality, agreement between methods, what is unverified.

answer.description: Optional 1-3 sentence direct answer under the headline.

kpis.description: Up to 6 cards. Each number must come from a script run.

delta.description: Like -17.3% vs Jul. Shown with an arrow, so colour is never the only signal.

good.description: Which direction is good news (default up). Use down for churn, cost, errors.

chart.description: One of svg_file (path relative to the JSON file, made by chart.py) or svg (inline markup).

rows.description: Each row has one cell per column.

method.description: What was done and with which scripts, in plain words. Include row counts and exclusions.

caveats.description: What could make the conclusion wrong.

data_quality.description: Issues found by profile.py and how they were handled.
